note: empty-sdk-refused: the pair empties a document whose importer throws; lolesports (valid OpenAPI, its example builder overflows on a required self-referencing allOf) keeps generating under the valid-OpenAPI exception, tacd (a null Media Type Object, invalid) is refused in both modes.
empty-sdk-refused: a Media Type Object written as null is invalid OpenAPI the pair empties; crozier refuses it in both modes as the new class null-media-type.

The pair resolves a header $ref into another operation's response headers and generates, so crozier does; a response or parameter $ref into #/paths/ empties the SDK, so DigitalOcean, dggs and Codat stay refused (empty-sdk-refused).
